title: Mar bar Chiya

paragraphs: In [Chullin 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.45b.7-8), Ameimar said in the name of Rav Nachman: “There are three tubes.” Mar bar Chiya teaches the reverse version. From this, Yuchasin deduces that he lived in Ameimar’s time.
He is also mentioned in [Bava Batra 165b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.165b.10-12), saying, “This is what they sent him from there,” addressed to Rabbi Yirmeyah.[^1]

notes.text: In Chullin Mar bar Chiya reverses the lung and liver rulings, while the dispute over the tube leading to the heart remains. In Bava Batra he gives a version of the question sent to Rabbi Yirmeyah.
